section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1968
title: 13 Distribution of suicides by age-groups in the States Union Territories and Cities. Appendix III presents the incidence of suicidal deaths in the States, Union Territories and Cities by three age groups viz : (a) Persons upto 18 years ; (b) Persons between 18 years to 30 years and (c) Above 30 years. It has been observed that, on an average, 43·7% of the persons who committed suicides were in the age group of 18 to 30 years. Almost all the States, Union Territories and Cities conform to all-India pattern in this regard.
